note: Rustic Mackinaw State Forest campground on a forested bluff along Twin Lake, 6 mi SE of Alverno via Smith and Twin Lakes roads (5754 Smith Road), Cheboygan County; managed by Cheboygan State Park. Bass, bluegill, splake, pike and the occasional rainbow trout. The Black Mountain Pathway (hiking, mountain biking) is a third of a mile east, and the campground is near the Black Mountain Recreation Area, with ORV trails and a scramble area nearby. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 11 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (standard wording, silent on length) (all confirmed, derived -> manual). Season (closed Oct 1 - May 1) already manual, left. Phone 231-627-2811 matches. Type 'rustic', not equestrian; the page tags 'ORV scramble area' and 'ORV trails or routes' and the table allows ORV operation between campground and trails, but it is not described as an ORV trail camp. Directions carry no road warning. The amenity table calls it 'Twin Lake State Forest Campground'; the page heading is 'Twin Lakes State Forest Campground' (kept). Note trimmed of field restatements.
